ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Impacket Tools Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of different compiled Windows binaries of the impacket toolset (based on names or part of their names - could lead to false positives)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\goldenPac.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\karmaSMB.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\kintercept.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\ntlmrelayx.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\rpcdump.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\samrdump.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\secretsdump.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\smbexec.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\smbrelayx.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\wmiexec.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\wmipersist.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\atexec\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\dcomexec\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\dpapi\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\findDelegation\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\GetADUsers\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\GetNPUsers\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\getPac\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\getST\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\getTGT\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\GetUserSPNs\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ifmap\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mimikatz\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netview\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nmapAnswerMachine\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opdump\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\psexec\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rdp\\_check\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sambaPipe\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\smbclient\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\smbserver\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sniff\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sniffer\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\split\\_windows\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ticketer\\_windows\\\.exe$")))
